subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the guard assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, does openclaw-secops approve these upstream action revisions for the privileged security and token workflows?
rationale: The source defects have a mechanical repair, but accepting new third-party code revisions in privileged workflows is an owner-controlled supply-chain decision.

options.title: Approve repaired batch
options.body: Review the upstream revisions and approve the complete batch after focused guards and exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Codex, and release-action updates into narrower owner-reviewed pull requests.

recommendation.title: Approve repaired batch
recommendation.body: Review the upstream revisions and approve the complete batch after focused guards and exact-head checks pass.
